_note: FA 2026 First Schedule Part I-A (pp.82–83) and Part I-B (pp.86–87), Paragraph F Table 1 Sl. 1: "(iii) where the total income (excluding dividend income or capital gains under the provisions of sections 111A, 112 and 112A [I-B: 196, 197 and 198]) exceeds Rs. 2,00,00,000 but does not exceed Rs. 5,00,00,000, at the rate of 25 per cent.; (iv) where the total income (excluding …) exceeds Rs. 5,00,00,000, at the rate of 37 per cent." The surcharge rate is not marginal: the band the income falls in sets one rate for the whole tax; W-056 looks the band up and takes the greater of this row's rate and the -EXCLUDING row's (D-084). The limit on the tax attributable to dividend income and the special gains (15%) is the -LIMIT row (rulebook RATE-SUR-SPLIT-001; W-088c, D-246); the excluding income is total income less dividend income and the special-rate capital gains. Spans TY 2025-26 (s.2, AY 2026-27) and TY 2026-27 (s.3): the same figures.
